name: SimpleGraph.KneserCounting.eventually_fingerprint_bounds
statement:
theorem eventually_fingerprint_bounds (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) (hεone : ε < 1) :
    ∃ n₀ : ℕ, ∀ n k : ℕ, n₀ ≤ n → 2 ≤ k → 2 * k + 1 ≤ n →
      fingerprintSize ε n k ≤ vertexCount n k ∧
        1 + (fingerprintSize ε n k : ℝ) +
            entropyCost (vertexCount n k) (fingerprintSize ε n k) ≤
          2 * ε * (starSize n k : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hC : 0 < ratioConstant ε := by
    rw [ratioConstant]
    positivity
  have hB : 0 < entropyConstant := by
    rw [entropyConstant]
    have hlogTwo : 0 < Real.log 2 := Real.log_pos one_lt_two
    positivity
  have hCB : 0 < ratioConstant ε * entropyConstant := mul_pos hC hB
  let δ := (2 * ε) / (ratioConstant ε * entropyConstant)
  have hδ : 0 < δ := by
    exact div_pos (by positivity) hCB
  obtain ⟨n₁, hn₁⟩ := eventually_one_add_log_sq_div_lt hδ
  refine ⟨max 2 n₁, ?_⟩
  intro n k hn hk hnk
  have hnTwo : 2 ≤ n := (le_max_left 2 n₁).trans hn
  have hn₁n : n₁ ≤ n := (le_max_right 2 n₁).trans hn
  have hsquare := hn₁ n hn₁n
  have hnReal : (2 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hnTwo
  have hlog : 0 ≤ Real.log (n : ℝ) := Real.log_nonneg (by linarith)
  have herror : asymptoticError ε n ≤ 2 * ε := by
    apply le_of_lt
    calc
      asymptoticError ε n ≤
            ratioConstant ε * entropyConstant *
              ((1 + Real.log (n : ℝ)) ^ 2 / (n : ℝ)) :=
          asymptoticError_le hε hnTwo
      _ < (ratioConstant ε * entropyConstant) *
            ((2 * ε) / (ratioConstant ε * entropyConstant)) :=
          mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hsquare hCB
      _ = 2 * ε := mul_div_cancel₀ _ hCB.ne'
  have hratioNonneg : 0 ≤ fingerprintRatioBound ε n := by
    rw [fingerprintRatioBound, ratioConstant]
    positivity
  have hfactorTwo :
      2 ≤ 2 + (1 + 2 * Real.log (n : ℝ)) / Real.log 2 := by
    exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (div_nonneg (by linarith) (Real.log_pos one_lt_two).le)
  have htwoRatio : 2 * fingerprintRatioBound ε n ≤ asymptoticError ε n := by
    calc
      2 * fingerprintRatioBound ε n = fingerprintRatioBound ε n * 2 := by ring
      _ ≤ fingerprintRatioBound ε n *
          (2 + (1 + 2 * Real.log (n : ℝ)) / Real.log 2) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hfactorTwo hratioNonneg
      _ = asymptoticError ε n := by rw [asymptoticError]
  have hratioOne : fingerprintRatioBound ε n < 1 := by
    nlinarith
  have hRN := containerThreshold_lt_vertexCount hεone hk hnk
  have hM : 0 < starSize n k := Nat.choose_pos (by omega)
  have hqReal :
      (fingerprintSize ε n k : ℝ) < (vertexCount n k : ℝ) := by
    calc
      (fingerprintSize ε n k : ℝ) <
          (starSize n k : ℝ) * fingerprintRatioBound ε n :=
        fingerprintSize_lt_star_mul_ratioBound hε hk hnk hRN
      _ < (starSize n k : ℝ) * 1 :=
        mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hratioOne (by exact_mod_cast hM)
      _ = (starSize n k : ℝ) := by rw [mul_one]
      _ ≤ (vertexCount n k : ℝ) := by
        exact_mod_cast starSize_le_vertexCount (by omega : 0 < k) (by omega : k ≤ n)
  have hqN : fingerprintSize ε n k ≤ vertexCount n k := by
    exact_mod_cast hqReal.le
  exact ⟨hqN, entropy_error_bound hε hk hnk hRN hratioOne.le herror⟩

name: SimpleGraph.KneserCounting.intersectingFamilyCount_lower_bound
statement:
theorem intersectingFamilyCount_lower_bound
    {n k : ℕ} (hk : 2 ≤ k) (hnk : 2 * k + 1 ≤ n) :
    2 ^ starSize n k ≤ intersectingFamilyCount n k
proof:
:= by
  exact pow_starSize_le_intersectingFamilyCount (by omega) (by omega)

name: SimpleGraph.KneserCounting.eventually_intersectingFamilyCount_le
statement:
theorem eventually_intersectingFamilyCount_le
    (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) (hεone : ε < 1) :
    ∃ n₀ : ℕ, ∀ n k : ℕ, n₀ < n → 2 ≤ k → 2 * k + 1 ≤ n →
      (intersectingFamilyCount n k : ℝ) ≤
        Real.rpow 2 ((1 + 3 * ε) * (starSize n k : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n₀, hparams⟩ := eventually_fingerprint_bounds ε hε hεone
  refine ⟨n₀, ?_⟩
  intro n k hn hk hnk
  obtain ⟨hq, hlarge⟩ := hparams n k hn.le hk hnk
  exact intersectingFamilyCount_le_of_entropy hε hk hnk
    (containerThreshold_lt_vertexCount hεone hk hnk) hq hlarge

name: SimpleGraph.min_spectrum_mul_dotProduct_le_of_isHermitian
statement:
private lemma min_spectrum_mul_dotProduct_le_of_isHermitian
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {a : ℝ} (ha : IsLeast (spectrum ℝ A) a) (x : ι → ℝ) :
    a * dotProduct x x ≤ dotProduct x (Matrix.mulVec A x)
proof:
:= by
  open scoped MatrixOrder in
    have hle :
        algebraMap ℝ (Matrix ι ι ℝ) a ≤ A :=
      algebraMap_le_of_le_spectrum ha.2 hA
    have hquad := hle.dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg x
    have hdiag :
        algebraMap ℝ (Matrix ι ι ℝ) a = Matrix.diagonal (fun _ ↦ a) := by
      ext i j
      simp [Matrix.algebraMap_eq_diagonal, Pi.algebraMap_apply, Matrix.diagonal_apply]
    rw [hdiag] at hquad
    simp only [Matrix.sub_mulVec, dotProduct_sub] at hquad
    simpa [dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Matrix.diagonal_apply, mul_sum, mul_comm,
      mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using hquad

name: SimpleGraph.indicator_dotProduct_adjMatrix_indicator
statement:
private lemma indicator_dotProduct_adjMatrix_indicator
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (S : Finset V) :
    let χ : V → ℝ := fun v ↦ if v ∈ S then 1 else 0
    dotProduct χ (Matrix.mulVec (G.adjMatrix ℝ) χ) =
      (2 * #(G.induce (S : Set V)).edgeFinset : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : Fintype (S : Set V) := FinsetCoe.fintype S
  dsimp
  have hnat :
      ∑ x ∈ S, #(S.filter fun y ↦ G.Adj x y) =
        2 * #(G.induce (S : Set V)).edgeFinset := by
    calc
      ∑ x ∈ S, #(S.filter fun y ↦ G.Adj x y) =
          ∑ x : (S : Set V), (G.induce (S : Set V)).degree x := by
            rw [← S.sum_attach]
            have hatt : S.attach = (Finset.univ : Finset (S : Set V)) := by
              ext x
              simp
            rw [hatt]
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro x _
            rw [← SimpleGraph.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree]
            have heq :
                S.filter (fun y ↦ G.Adj x y) =
                  ((G.induce (S : Set V)).neighborFinset x).map
                    (Function.Embedding.subtype fun x ↦ x ∈ (S : Set V)) := by
              ext y
              simp [and_comm]
            rw [heq, Finset.card_map]
      _ = 2 * #(G.induce (S : Set V)).edgeFinset :=
        (G.induce (S : Set V)).sum_degrees_eq_twice_card_edges
  calc
    dotProduct (fun v ↦ if v ∈ S then 1 else 0)
        (Matrix.mulVec (G.adjMatrix ℝ) (fun v ↦ if v ∈ S then 1 else 0)) =
        ((∑ x ∈ S, #(S.filter fun y ↦ G.Adj x y) : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
      simp [dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, SimpleGraph.adjMatrix]
    _ = (2 * #(G.induce (S : Set V)).edgeFinset : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast hnat

name: SimpleGraph.expander_mixing_induced_edge_count
statement:
theorem expander_mixing_induced_edge_count
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    {D : ℕ} {lam : ℝ}
    (hreg : G.IsRegularOfDegree D)
    (hlam : IsLeast (spectrum ℝ (G.adjMatrix ℝ)) lam)
    (S : Finset V) :
    (D : ℝ) / (2 * (Fintype.card V : ℝ)) * (S.card : ℝ) ^ 2 +
        lam / (2 * (Fintype.card V : ℝ)) * (S.card : ℝ) *
          ((Fintype.card V : ℝ) - (S.card : ℝ)) ≤
      (#(G.induce (S : Set V)).edgeFinset : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty V with
  | inl _ =>
      simp
  | inr _ =>
      let χ : V → ℝ := fun v ↦ if v ∈ S then 1 else 0
      let one : V → ℝ := fun _ ↦ 1
      let N : ℝ := Fintype.card V
      let s : ℝ := S.card
      let c : ℝ := s / N
      let x : V → ℝ := χ - c • one
      have hN : 0 < N := by
        have hNnat : 0 < Fintype.card V :=
          Fintype.card_pos_iff.mpr (inferInstance : Nonempty V)
        dsimp [N]
        exact_mod_cast hNnat
      have hNne : N ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hN
      have hχsum : dotProduct χ one = s := by
        simp [dotProduct, χ, one, s]
      have hχχ : dotProduct χ χ = s := by
        simp [dotProduct, χ, s]
      have honeone : dotProduct one one = N := by
        simp [dotProduct, one, N]
      have hAone : Matrix.mulVec (G.adjMatrix ℝ) one = (D : ℝ) • one := by
        funext v
        simpa [one] using
          (G.adjMatrix_mulVec_const_apply_of_regular (α := ℝ) hreg (a := (1 : ℝ)) (v := v))
      have hχAχ :
          dotProduct χ (Matrix.mulVec (G.adjMatrix ℝ) χ) =
            (2 * #(G.induce (S : Set V)).edgeFinset : ℝ) :=
        indicator_dotProduct_adjMatrix_indicator G S
      have hχAone :
          dotProduct χ (Matrix.mulVec (G.adjMatrix ℝ) one) = (D : ℝ) * s := by
        rw [hAone]
        simp [dotProduct_smul, hχsum]
      have honeAχ :
          dotProduct one (Matrix.mulVec (G.adjMatrix ℝ) χ) = (D : ℝ) * s := by
        calc
          dotProduct one (Matrix.mulVec (G.adjMatrix ℝ) χ) =
              dotProduct one (Matrix.mulVec (Matrix.transpose (G.adjMatrix ℝ)) χ) := by
                rw [G.transpose_adjMatrix]
          _ = dotProduct χ (Matrix.mulVec (G.adjMatrix ℝ) one) :=
            Matrix.dotProduct_transpose_mulVec _ _ _
          _ = (D : ℝ) * s := hχAone
      have honeAone :
          dotProduct one (Matrix.mulVec (G.adjMatrix ℝ) one) = (D : ℝ) * N := by
        rw [hAone]
        simp [dotProduct_smul, honeone]
      have hxx : dotProduct x x = s - s ^ 2 / N := by
        dsimp [x, c]
        rw [sub_dotProduct, dotProduct_sub, dotProduct_sub]
        simp only [smul_dotProduct, dotProduct_smul, hχχ, hχsum, dotProduct_comm one χ,
          honeone, smul_eq_mul]
        field_simp
        ring
      have hxAx :
          dotProduct x (Matrix.mulVec (G.adjMatrix ℝ) x) =
            (2 * #(G.induce (S : Set V)).edgeFinset : ℝ) - (D : ℝ) * s ^ 2 / N := by
        dsimp [x, c]
        rw [Matrix.mulVec_sub, Matrix.mulVec_smul, sub_dotProduct, dotProduct_sub,
          dotProduct_sub]
        simp only [smul_dotProduct, dotProduct_smul, hχAχ, hχAone, honeAχ, honeAone,
          smul_eq_mul]
        field_simp
        ring
      have hHerm : (G.adjMatrix ℝ).IsHermitian := by
        rw [Matrix.isHermitian_iff_isSymm]
        exact G.transpose_adjMatrix
      have hspectral := min_spectrum_mul_dotProduct_le_of_isHermitian hHerm hlam x
      rw [hxx, hxAx] at hspectral
      dsimp [N, s] at hspectral ⊢
      have hcardne : (Fintype.card V : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
        have hnpos : 0 < Fintype.card V :=
          Fintype.card_pos_iff.mpr (inferInstance : Nonempty V)
        exact_mod_cast hnpos.ne'
      field_simp [hcardne] at hspectral ⊢
      nlinarith

name: SimpleGraph.KneserCounting.isRegularOfDegree_graph
statement:
theorem isRegularOfDegree_graph (n : ℕ) {k : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k) :
    (graph n k).IsRegularOfDegree (regularDegree n k)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro A
  let valEmbedding : Vertex n k ↪ Finset (Fin n) :=
    ⟨fun B ↦ (B : Finset (Fin n)), fun _ _ h ↦ Subtype.ext h⟩
  have hmap :
      ((graph n k).neighborFinset A).map valEmbedding =
        ((A : Finset (Fin n))ᶜ).powersetCard k := by
    ext B
    simp only [Finset.mem_map, SimpleGraph.mem_neighborFinset, Finset.mem_powersetCard]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨B', hB'A, rfl⟩
      have hdisjoint := (graph_adj_iff_disjoint n k hk).mp hB'A
      refine ⟨?_, Set.powersetCard.card_eq B'⟩
      intro x hxB
      exact Finset.mem_compl.mpr fun hxA ↦
        Finset.disjoint_left.mp hdisjoint hxA hxB
    · rintro ⟨hBA, hBcard⟩
      let B' : Vertex n k := ⟨B, hBcard⟩
      refine ⟨B', (graph_adj_iff_disjoint n k hk).mpr ?_, rfl⟩
      exact Finset.disjoint_left.mpr fun x hxA hxB ↦
        (Finset.mem_compl.mp (hBA hxB)) hxA
  calc
    (graph n k).degree A = #((graph n k).neighborFinset A) := rfl
    _ = #(((graph n k).neighborFinset A).map valEmbedding) := (Finset.card_map _).symm
    _ = #(((A : Finset (Fin n))ᶜ).powersetCard k) := by rw [hmap]
    _ = ((n - k).choose k) := by
      rw [Finset.card_powersetCard, Finset.card_compl, Fintype.card_fin,
        Set.powersetCard.card_eq A]
    _ = regularDegree n k := rfl

name: SimpleGraph.KneserCounting.kneser_supersaturation_of_isLeast
statement:
theorem kneser_supersaturation_of_isLeast
    {ε : ℝ} {n k : ℕ}
    (hε : 0 < ε) (hk : 0 < k) (hnk : 2 * k + 1 ≤ n)
    (hmin : IsLeast (spectrum ℝ ((graph n k).adjMatrix ℝ))
      (-((k : ℝ) / (((n - k : ℕ) : ℝ)) * (regularDegree n k : ℝ))))
    (S : Finset (Vertex n k))
    (hS : (1 + ε) * (starSize n k : ℝ) ≤ (S.card : ℝ)) :
    densityParameter ε n k * (S.card.choose 2 : ℝ) ≤
      (#((graph n k).induce (S : Set (Vertex n k))).edgeFinset : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let N : ℝ := vertexCount n k
  let D : ℝ := regularDegree n k
  let M : ℝ := starSize n k
  let s : ℝ := S.card
  let d : ℝ := ((n - k : ℕ) : ℝ)
  have hnpos : 0 < n := by omega
  have hkle : k ≤ n := by omega
  have hdNat : 0 < n - k := by omega
  have hNnat : 0 < vertexCount n k := by
    exact Nat.choose_pos hkle
  have hN : 0 < N := by
    dsimp [N]
    exact_mod_cast hNnat
  have hD : 0 ≤ D := by positivity
  have hs : 0 ≤ s := by positivity
  have hd : 0 < d := by
    dsimp [d]
    exact_mod_cast hdNat
  have hdiff : d + (k : ℝ) = (n : ℝ) := by
    dsimp [d]
    exact_mod_cast Nat.sub_add_cancel hkle
  have he : 0 < 1 + ε := by linarith
  have hstarNat :
      n * starSize n k = k * vertexCount n k := by
    simpa [starSize, vertexCount, Nat.sub_add_cancel hnpos,
      Nat.sub_add_cancel hk, mul_comm] using Nat.add_one_mul_choose_eq (n - 1) (k - 1)
  have hstar : (n : ℝ) * M = (k : ℝ) * N := by
    dsimp [M, N]
    exact_mod_cast hstarNat
  have hmixed :=
    SimpleGraph.expander_mixing_induced_edge_count (graph n k)
      (isRegularOfDegree_graph n hk) hmin S
  rw [card_vertex] at hmixed
  change
    D / (2 * N) * s ^ 2 +
        (-((k : ℝ) / d * D)) / (2 * N) * s * (N - s) ≤
      (#((graph n k).induce (S : Set (Vertex n k))).edgeFinset : ℝ) at hmixed
  have hchoose : (S.card.choose 2 : ℝ) ≤ s ^ 2 / 2 := by
    rw [Nat.cast_choose_two]
    have hsub : ((S.card - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ s := by
      dsimp [s]
      exact_mod_cast Nat.sub_le S.card 1
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsub hs]
  have hdensity : 0 ≤ densityParameter ε n k := by
    rw [densityParameter]
    positivity
  calc
    densityParameter ε n k * (S.card.choose 2 : ℝ) ≤
        densityParameter ε n k * (s ^ 2 / 2) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hchoose hdensity
    _ ≤ D / (2 * N) * s ^ 2 +
        (-((k : ℝ) / d * D)) / (2 * N) * s * (N - s) := by
      have hid :
          (D / (2 * N) * s ^ 2 +
              (-((k : ℝ) / d * D)) / (2 * N) * s * (N - s)) -
              densityParameter ε n k * (s ^ 2 / 2) =
            D * s * (n : ℝ) / (2 * N * d * (1 + ε)) *
              (s - (1 + ε) * M) := by
        rw [densityParameter]
        dsimp [D, N, M, d]
        field_simp
        dsimp [N, M] at hstar
        dsimp [d] at hdiff
        linear_combination
          (D * s * (1 + ε)) * hstar +
          (D * s ^ 2 * (1 + ε)) * hdiff
      have hfactor :
          0 ≤ D * s * (n : ℝ) / (2 * N * d * (1 + ε)) := by positivity
      have hthreshold : 0 ≤ s - (1 + ε) * M := by
        dsimp [s, M]
        exact sub_nonneg.mpr hS
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg hfactor hthreshold]
    _ ≤ (#((graph n k).induce (S : Set (Vertex n k))).edgeFinset : ℝ) := hmixed

name: SimpleGraph.KneserCounting.kneser_supersaturation
statement:
theorem kneser_supersaturation
    {ε : ℝ} {n k : ℕ}
    (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hk : 0 < k)
    (hnk : 2 * k + 1 ≤ n)
    (S : Finset (Vertex n k))
    (hS :
      (1 + ε) * (starSize n k : ℝ) ≤ (S.card : ℝ)) :
    densityParameter ε n k * (S.card.choose 2 : ℝ) ≤
      (#((graph n k).induce
        (S : Set (Vertex n k))).edgeFinset : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  exact kneser_supersaturation_of_isLeast
    hε hk hnk
    (kneser_least_eigenvalue
      (n := n) (k := k) hk hnk)
    S hS

name: SimpleGraph.KneserCounting.card_vertex
statement: theorem card_vertex : Fintype.card (Vertex n k) = vertexCount n k

name: SimpleGraph.KneserCounting.graph_adj_iff
statement:
@[simp] theorem graph_adj_iff {A B : Vertex n k} :
    (graph n k).Adj A B ↔
      A ≠ B ∧ Disjoint (A : Finset (Fin n)) (B : Finset (Fin n))
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: SimpleGraph.KneserCounting.graph_adj_iff_disjoint
statement:
theorem graph_adj_iff_disjoint (hk : 0 < k) {A B : Vertex n k} :
    (graph n k).Adj A B ↔ Disjoint (A : Finset (Fin n)) (B : Finset (Fin n))
proof:
:= by
  rw [graph_adj_iff]
  refine and_iff_right_of_imp fun hdisjoint hAB ↦ ?_
  subst B
  have hAempty : (A : Finset (Fin n)) = ∅ :=
    Finset.disjoint_self_iff_empty (A : Finset (Fin n)) |>.mp hdisjoint

    simpa [hAempty] using (Set.powersetCard.card_eq A).symm

name: SimpleGraph.KneserCounting.isIntersecting_iff_isIndepSet
statement:
theorem isIntersecting_iff_isIndepSet (hk : 0 < k) (𝒜 : Finset (Vertex n k)) :
    IsIntersecting n k 𝒜 ↔ (graph n k).IsIndepSet 𝒜
proof:
:= by
  rw [SimpleGraph.isIndepSet_iff]
  constructor
  · intro h A hA B hB _hAB hadj
    apply h
    · exact ⟨A, hA, rfl⟩
    · exact ⟨B, hB, rfl⟩
    · exact (graph_adj_iff_disjoint n k hk).mp hadj
  · intro h
    rintro A ⟨A', hA', rfl⟩ B ⟨B', hB', rfl⟩ hdisjoint
    have hadj : (graph n k).Adj A' B' :=
      (graph_adj_iff_disjoint n k hk).mpr hdisjoint
    exact (h hA' hB' ((graph_adj_iff n k).mp hadj).1) hadj

@[simp] theorem mem_intersectingFamilies {𝒜 : Finset (Vertex n k)} :

:= by
  classical
  simp [intersectingFamilies]

name: SimpleGraph.KneserCounting.intersectingFamilyCount_pos
statement: theorem intersectingFamilyCount_pos (n k : ℕ) : 0 < intersectingFamilyCount n k
proof:

name: SimpleGraph.KneserCounting.card_star
statement:
theorem card_star (i : Fin n) {k : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k) :
    #(star n i k) = starSize n k
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let valEmbedding : Vertex n k ↪ Finset (Fin n) :=
    ⟨fun A ↦ (A : Finset (Fin n)), fun _ _ h ↦ Subtype.ext h⟩
  have hmap :
      (star n i k).map valEmbedding =
        ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).powersetCard k).filter (i ∈ ·) := by
    ext A
    simp [star, valEmbedding, Finset.mem_powersetCard, and_comm]
  calc
    #(star n i k) = #((star n i k).map valEmbedding) := (Finset.card_map _).symm
    _ = #(((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).powersetCard k).filter (i ∈ ·)) := by
      rw [hmap]
    _ = #(((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).powersetCard k).filter ({i} ⊆ ·)) := by
      congr 2
      ext A
      simp
    _ = Nat.choose (#(Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)) - #{i}) (k - #{i}) :=
      Finset.card_filter_powersetCard_subset {i} Finset.univ k
        (Finset.subset_univ _) (by rw [Finset.card_singleton]; exact hk)
    _ = starSize n k := by simp [starSize]

name: SimpleGraph.KneserCounting.pow_starSize_le_intersectingFamilyCount
statement:
theorem pow_starSize_le_intersectingFamilyCount
    {n k : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hk : 0 < k) :
    2 ^ starSize n k ≤ intersectingFamilyCount n k
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let i : Fin n := ⟨0, hn⟩
  have hsubset : (star n i k).powerset ⊆ intersectingFamilies n k := by
    intro 𝒜 h𝒜
    rw [mem_intersectingFamilies, IsIntersecting, underlyingFamily]
    rintro A ⟨A', hA', rfl⟩ B ⟨B', hB', rfl⟩
    have h𝒜star : 𝒜 ⊆ star n i k := Finset.mem_powerset.mp h𝒜
    have hiA : i ∈ (A' : Finset (Fin n)) :=
      (Finset.mem_filter.mp (h𝒜star hA')).2
    have hiB : i ∈ (B' : Finset (Fin n)) :=
      (Finset.mem_filter.mp (h𝒜star hB')).2
    exact Finset.not_disjoint_iff.mpr ⟨i, hiA, hiB⟩
  calc
    2 ^ starSize n k = #((star n i k).powerset) := by
      rw [Finset.card_powerset, card_star n i hk]
    _ ≤ #(intersectingFamilies n k) := Finset.card_le_card hsubset
    _ = intersectingFamilyCount n k := rfl

name: SimpleGraph.KneserCounting.eventually_intersectingFamilyCount_lt
statement:
theorem eventually_intersectingFamilyCount_lt
    (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ n₀ : ℕ, ∀ n k : ℕ, n₀ ≤ n → 3 ≤ k → 2 * k + 1 ≤ n →
      (intersectingFamilyCount n k : ℝ) <
        Real.rpow 2 ((1 + 3 * ε) * (((n - 1).choose (k - 1) : ℕ) : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  let δ : ℝ := min (ε / 2) (1 / 2)
  have hδ : 0 < δ := by
    dsimp [δ]
    rw [lt_min_iff]
    constructor <;> positivity
  have hδone : δ < 1 := by
    calc
      δ ≤ 1 / 2 := min_le_right _ _
      _ < 1 := by norm_num
  have hδε : δ < ε := by
    calc
      δ ≤ ε / 2 := min_le_left _ _
      _ < ε := by linarith
  obtain ⟨n₁, hn₁⟩ := eventually_intersectingFamilyCount_le δ hδ hδone
  refine ⟨n₁ + 1, ?_⟩
  intro n k hn hk hnk
  have hupper := hn₁ n k (by omega) (by omega) hnk
  let M : ℝ := (((n - 1).choose (k - 1) : ℕ) : ℝ)
  have hMnat : 0 < (n - 1).choose (k - 1) := Nat.choose_pos (by omega)
  have hM : 0 < M := by
    dsimp [M]
    exact_mod_cast hMnat
  have hexponent :
      (1 + 3 * δ) * M < (1 + 3 * ε) * M := by
    nlinarith
  have hrpow :
      Real.rpow 2 ((1 + 3 * δ) * M) < Real.rpow 2 ((1 + 3 * ε) * M) :=
    Real.rpow_lt_rpow_of_exponent_lt one_lt_two hexponent
  have hupper' :
      (intersectingFamilyCount n k : ℝ) ≤ Real.rpow 2 ((1 + 3 * δ) * M) := by
    simpa [M, starSize] using hupper
  simpa [M] using hupper'.trans_lt hrpow

name: SimpleGraph.KneserCounting.incidenceSpace_mono
statement:
private lemma incidenceSpace_mono {n k i j : ℕ} (hij : i ≤ j) :
    incidenceSpace n k i ≤ incidenceSpace n k j
proof:
:= by
  apply Submodule.span_mono
  rintro x ⟨J, hJ, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨J, hJ.trans hij, rfl⟩

name: SimpleGraph.KneserCounting.incidenceVector_mem
statement:
private lemma incidenceVector_mem (n k : ℕ) {i : ℕ} {J : Finset (Fin n)} (hJ : #J ≤ i) :
    incidenceVector n k J ∈ incidenceSpace n k i
proof:
:= by
  exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨J, hJ, rfl⟩

name: SimpleGraph.KneserCounting.incidenceSpace_top
statement: private lemma incidenceSpace_top (n k : ℕ) : incidenceSpace n k k = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  apply top_unique
  intro x _
  classical
  have hsingle (A : Vertex n k) :
      Pi.single A (x A) = (x A) • incidenceVector n k (A : Finset (Fin n)) := by
    funext B
    by_cases hAB : A = B
    · subst B
      simp [incidenceVector]
    · have hnsub : ¬ (A : Finset (Fin n)) ⊆ (B : Finset (Fin n)) := by
        intro hsub
        apply hAB
        apply Subtype.ext
        apply Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le hsub
        simp [Set.powersetCard.card_eq A, Set.powersetCard.card_eq B]
      simp [hAB, incidenceVector, hnsub]
  rw [← Finset.univ_sum_single x]
  exact Submodule.sum_mem _ fun A _ ↦ by
    rw [hsingle]
    have hcard : #(A : Finset (Fin n)) ≤ k := by
      rw [Set.powersetCard.card_eq A]
    exact (incidenceSpace n k k).smul_mem (x A)
      (incidenceVector_mem n k hcard)

name: SimpleGraph.KneserCounting.choose_diagonal_mono
statement:
private lemma choose_diagonal_mono (a b t : ℕ) :
    a.choose b ≤ (a + t).choose (b + t)
proof:
:= by
  induction t with
  | zero => simp
  | succ t ih =>
      calc
        a.choose b ≤ (a + t).choose (b + t) := ih
        _ ≤ (a + t + 1).choose (b + t + 1) := by
          rw [Nat.choose_succ_succ']
          omega
        _ = (a + (t + 1)).choose (b + (t + 1)) := by simp [Nat.add_assoc]

name: SimpleGraph.KneserCounting.inclusion_exclusion_incidence
statement:
private lemma inclusion_exclusion_incidence (n k : ℕ) (J : Finset (Fin n))
    (A : Vertex n k) :
    ∑ L ∈ J.powerset,
        (-1 : ℝ) ^ #L * incidenceVector n k L A =
      if Disjoint J (A : Finset (Fin n)) then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hfilter :
      J.powerset.filter (· ⊆ (A : Finset (Fin n))) =
        (J ∩ (A : Finset (Fin n))).powerset := by
    ext L
    simp only [mem_filter, mem_powerset, subset_inter_iff]
  simp only [incidenceVector]
  simp_rw [mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero]
  rw [← Finset.sum_filter, hfilter]
  by_cases hdis : Disjoint J (A : Finset (Fin n))
  · have hinter : J ∩ (A : Finset (Fin n)) = ∅ := Finset.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty.mp hdis
    simp [hdis, hinter]
  · have hinter : (J ∩ (A : Finset (Fin n))).Nonempty := by
      simpa [Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty, Finset.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty] using hdis
    rw [if_neg hdis]
    exact_mod_cast
      (Finset.sum_powerset_neg_one_pow_card_of_nonempty
        (x := J ∩ (A : Finset (Fin n))) hinter)

name: SimpleGraph.KneserCounting.adjacencyOperator_apply
statement:
private lemma adjacencyOperator_apply (n k : ℕ) (x : Vertex n k → ℝ)
    (A : Vertex n k) :
    adjacencyOperator n k x A =
      ∑ B : Vertex n k, if (graph n k).Adj A B then x B else 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [adjacencyOperator, Matrix.toLin'_apply, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct,
    SimpleGraph.adjMatrix_apply]

name: SimpleGraph.KneserCounting.card_disjoint_supersets
statement:
private lemma card_disjoint_supersets
    {n k : ℕ} (A : Vertex n k) (J : Finset (Fin n))
    (hJk : #J ≤ k) (hdis : Disjoint J (A : Finset (Fin n))) :
    #((Finset.univ : Finset (Vertex n k)).filter (fun B : Vertex n k ↦
        Disjoint (A : Finset (Fin n)) (B : Finset (Fin n)) ∧
          J ⊆ (B : Finset (Fin n)))) =
      (n - k - #J).choose (k - #J)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let valEmbedding : Vertex n k ↪ Finset (Fin n) :=
    ⟨fun B ↦ (B : Finset (Fin n)), fun _ _ h ↦ Subtype.ext h⟩
  let F : Finset (Vertex n k) :=
    (Finset.univ : Finset (Vertex n k)).filter (fun B : Vertex n k ↦
      Disjoint (A : Finset (Fin n)) (B : Finset (Fin n)) ∧
        J ⊆ (B : Finset (Fin n)))
  have hmap :
      F.map valEmbedding =
        (((A : Finset (Fin n)))ᶜ.powersetCard k).filter (J ⊆ ·) := by
    ext B
    simp only [F, mem_map, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, mem_powersetCard]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨B', ⟨hdisAB, hJB'⟩, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨⟨fun x hxB ↦ Finset.mem_compl.mpr fun hxA ↦
        Finset.disjoint_left.mp hdisAB hxA hxB,
        Set.powersetCard.card_eq B'⟩, hJB'⟩
    · rintro ⟨⟨hBcomp, hBcard⟩, hJB⟩
      let B' : Vertex n k := ⟨B, hBcard⟩
      refine ⟨B', ⟨?_, hJB⟩, rfl⟩
      exact Finset.disjoint_left.mpr fun x hxA hxB ↦
        (Finset.mem_compl.mp (hBcomp hxB)) hxA
  have hJcomp : J ⊆ ((A : Finset (Fin n)))ᶜ := by
    intro x hxJ
    exact Finset.mem_compl.mpr fun hxA ↦ Finset.disjoint_left.mp hdis hxJ hxA
  change #F = _
  calc
    #F = #(F.map valEmbedding) := (Finset.card_map _).symm
    _ = #((((A : Finset (Fin n)))ᶜ.powersetCard k).filter (J ⊆ ·)) := by rw [hmap]
    _ = ((#((A : Finset (Fin n)))ᶜ - #J).choose (k - #J)) :=
      Finset.card_filter_powersetCard_subset J ((A : Finset (Fin n)))ᶜ k hJcomp hJk
    _ = (n - k - #J).choose (k - #J) := by
      rw [Finset.card_compl, Fintype.card_fin, Set.powersetCard.card_eq A]

name: SimpleGraph.KneserCounting.adjacency_incidenceVector
statement:
private lemma adjacency_incidenceVector
    {n k : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k) (J : Finset (Fin n)) (hJk : #J ≤ k) :
    adjacencyOperator n k (incidenceVector n k J) =
      ((n - k - #J).choose (k - #J) : ℝ) •
        (fun A : Vertex n k ↦
          if Disjoint J (A : Finset (Fin n)) then 1 else 0)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  funext A
  rw [adjacencyOperator_apply]
  simp only [Pi.smul_apply]
  by_cases hdis : Disjoint J (A : Finset (Fin n))
  · rw [if_pos hdis]
    simp only [smul_eq_mul, mul_one, incidenceVector]
    calc
      (∑ B : Vertex n k,
          if (graph n k).Adj A B then
            (if J ⊆ (B : Finset (Fin n)) then 1 else 0)
          else 0) =
          ∑ B : Vertex n k,
            if Disjoint (A : Finset (Fin n)) (B : Finset (Fin n)) ∧
                J ⊆ (B : Finset (Fin n)) then 1 else 0 := by
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro B _
            by_cases hadj : (graph n k).Adj A B
            · have hAB : Disjoint (A : Finset (Fin n)) (B : Finset (Fin n)) :=
                (graph_adj_iff_disjoint n k hk).mp hadj
              have hne : A ≠ B := ((graph_adj_iff n k).mp hadj).1
              simp [hne, hAB]
            · have hnAB : ¬ Disjoint (A : Finset (Fin n)) (B : Finset (Fin n)) :=
                fun hAB ↦ hadj ((graph_adj_iff_disjoint n k hk).mpr hAB)
              simp [hnAB]
      _ = (#((Finset.univ : Finset (Vertex n k)).filter (fun B : Vertex n k ↦
          Disjoint (A : Finset (Fin n)) (B : Finset (Fin n)) ∧
            J ⊆ (B : Finset (Fin n)))) : ℝ) := by simp
      _ = ((n - k - #J).choose (k - #J) : ℝ) := by
        exact_mod_cast card_disjoint_supersets A J hJk hdis
  · rw [if_neg hdis]
    simp only [smul_eq_mul, mul_zero]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro B _
    by_cases hadj : (graph n k).Adj A B
    · rw [if_pos hadj]
      have hAB : Disjoint (A : Finset (Fin n)) (B : Finset (Fin n)) :=
        (graph_adj_iff_disjoint n k hk).mp hadj
      have hnJB : ¬ J ⊆ (B : Finset (Fin n)) := by
        intro hJB
        apply hdis
        exact hAB.symm.mono_left hJB
      simp [incidenceVector, hnJB]
    · rw [if_neg hadj]

name: SimpleGraph.KneserCounting.adjacency_incidence_expansion
statement:
private lemma adjacency_incidence_expansion
    {n k : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k) (J : Finset (Fin n)) (hJk : #J ≤ k) :
    adjacencyOperator n k (incidenceVector n k J) =
      ((n - k - #J).choose (k - #J) : ℝ) •
        ∑ L ∈ J.powerset, (-1 : ℝ) ^ #L • incidenceVector n k L
proof:
:= by
  rw [adjacency_incidenceVector hk J hJk]
  congr 1
  funext A
  simp only [Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  exact (inclusion_exclusion_incidence n k J A).symm

name: SimpleGraph.KneserCounting.adjacency_incidence_mem
statement:
private lemma adjacency_incidence_mem
    {n k : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k) (J : Finset (Fin n)) (hJk : #J ≤ k) :
    adjacencyOperator n k (incidenceVector n k J) ∈ incidenceSpace n k #J
proof:
:= by
  rw [adjacency_incidence_expansion hk J hJk]
  apply Submodule.smul_mem
  apply Submodule.sum_mem
  intro L hL
  apply Submodule.smul_mem
  exact incidenceVector_mem n k (Finset.card_le_card (Finset.mem_powerset.mp hL))

name: SimpleGraph.KneserCounting.adjacency_incidence_sub_eigenvalue_mem
statement:
private lemma adjacency_incidence_sub_eigenvalue_mem
    {n k i : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k) (hi : i ≤ k)
    (J : Finset (Fin n)) (hJi : #J = i) :
    adjacencyOperator n k (incidenceVector n k J) -
        kneserEigenvalue n k i • incidenceVector n k J ∈
      incidenceSpace n k (i - 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hJk : #J ≤ k := hJi.le.trans hi
  rw [adjacency_incidence_expansion hk J hJk]
  have hJmem : J ∈ J.powerset := Finset.mem_powerset.mpr Subset.rfl
  rw [← Finset.sum_erase_add _ _ hJmem]
  simp only [hJi, kneserEigenvalue, smul_add, smul_smul]
  have hcoeff :
      ((n - k - i).choose (k - i) : ℝ) * (-1 : ℝ) ^ i =
        (-1 : ℝ) ^ i * ((n - k - i).choose (k - i) : ℝ) := by ring
  rw [hcoeff, add_sub_cancel_right]
  apply Submodule.smul_mem
  apply Submodule.sum_mem
  intro L hL
  apply Submodule.smul_mem
  have hLpow : L ∈ J.powerset := (Finset.mem_erase.mp hL).2
  have hLne : L ≠ J := (Finset.mem_erase.mp hL).1
  have hLlt : #L < #J :=
    Finset.card_lt_card (Finset.ssubset_iff_subset_ne.mpr
      ⟨Finset.mem_powerset.mp hLpow, hLne⟩)
  apply incidenceVector_mem n k
  omega

name: SimpleGraph.KneserCounting.adjacency_incidence_zero_layer
statement:
private lemma adjacency_incidence_zero_layer
    {n k : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k) (J : Finset (Fin n)) (hJ : #J ≤ 0) :
    adjacencyOperator n k (incidenceVector n k J) =
      kneserEigenvalue n k 0 • incidenceVector n k J
proof:
:= by
  have hJempty : J = ∅ := Finset.card_eq_zero.mp (Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero hJ)
  subst J
  rw [adjacency_incidence_expansion hk ∅ (by simp)]
  simp [kneserEigenvalue]

name: SimpleGraph.KneserCounting.adjacency_eq_eigenvalue_on_zero_layer
statement:
private lemma adjacency_eq_eigenvalue_on_zero_layer
    {n k : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k) {x : Vertex n k → ℝ}
    (hx : x ∈ incidenceSpace n k 0) :
    adjacencyOperator n k x = kneserEigenvalue n k 0 • x
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
      rcases hx with ⟨J, hJ, rfl⟩
      exact adjacency_incidence_zero_layer hk J hJ
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => simp [map_add, hx, hy, smul_add]
  | smul a x _ hx => simp [map_smul, hx, smul_smul, mul_comm]

name: SimpleGraph.KneserCounting.adjacency_sub_eigenvalue_mem_prev
statement:
private lemma adjacency_sub_eigenvalue_mem_prev
    {n k i : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k) (hi : i ≤ k) (hi0 : 0 < i)
    {x : Vertex n k → ℝ} (hx : x ∈ incidenceSpace n k i) :
    adjacencyOperator n k x - kneserEigenvalue n k i • x ∈
      incidenceSpace n k (i - 1)
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
      rcases hx with ⟨J, hJi, rfl⟩
      by_cases hcard : #J = i
      · exact adjacency_incidence_sub_eigenvalue_mem hk hi J hcard
      · have hcardlt : #J < i := lt_of_le_of_ne hJi hcard
        apply Submodule.sub_mem
        · exact incidenceSpace_mono (by omega) <|
            adjacency_incidence_mem hk J (hJi.trans hi)
        · exact (incidenceSpace n k (i - 1)).smul_mem _
            (incidenceVector_mem n k (by omega))
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy =>
      simpa [map_add, smul_add, add_sub_add_comm] using
        (incidenceSpace n k (i - 1)).add_mem hx hy
  | smul a x _ hx =>
      simpa [map_smul, smul_smul, mul_comm, smul_sub] using
        (incidenceSpace n k (i - 1)).smul_mem a hx

name: SimpleGraph.KneserCounting.hasEigenvalue_eq_kneserEigenvalue
statement:
private lemma hasEigenvalue_eq_kneserEigenvalue
    {n k : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k) {μ : ℝ}
    (hμ : Module.End.HasEigenvalue (adjacencyOperator n k) μ) :
    ∃ i ≤ k, μ = kneserEigenvalue n k i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hμ.exists_hasEigenvector
  have hxne : x ≠ 0 := hx.2
  have hxapply : adjacencyOperator n k x = μ • x := hx.apply_eq_smul
  let P : ℕ → Prop := fun i ↦ x ∈ incidenceSpace n k i
  have hP : ∃ i, P i := by
    refine ⟨k, ?_⟩
    dsimp [P]
    rw [incidenceSpace_top]
    exact Submodule.mem_top
  let i := Nat.find hP
  have hxi : x ∈ incidenceSpace n k i := Nat.find_spec hP
  have hik : i ≤ k := Nat.find_min' hP (by
    dsimp [P]
    rw [incidenceSpace_top]
    exact Submodule.mem_top)
  refine ⟨i, hik, ?_⟩
  by_cases hi : i = 0
  · have hxi0 : x ∈ incidenceSpace n k 0 := by simpa [hi] using hxi
    have hxzero := adjacency_eq_eigenvalue_on_zero_layer hk hxi0
    simpa [hi] using smul_left_injective ℝ hxne (hxapply.symm.trans hxzero)
  · have hi0 : 0 < i := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hi
    have hrem := adjacency_sub_eigenvalue_mem_prev hk hik hi0 hxi
    rw [hxapply, ← sub_smul] at hrem
    by_contra hne
    have hscalar : μ - kneserEigenvalue n k i ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hne
    have hxprev := (incidenceSpace n k (i - 1)).smul_mem
      (μ - kneserEigenvalue n k i)⁻¹ hrem
    simp only [smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hscalar, one_smul] at hxprev
    exact Nat.find_min hP (by omega) hxprev

name: SimpleGraph.KneserCounting.kneserEigenvalue_one_le
statement:
private lemma kneserEigenvalue_one_le
    {n k i : ℕ} (hnk : 2 * k + 1 ≤ n) (hi : i ≤ k) :
    kneserEigenvalue n k 1 ≤ kneserEigenvalue n k i
proof:
:= by
  rcases neg_one_pow_eq_or ℝ i with hsign | hsign
  · have hleft : 0 ≤ ((n - k - 1).choose (k - 1) : ℝ) := by positivity
    have hright : 0 ≤ ((n - k - i).choose (k - i) : ℝ) := by positivity
    unfold kneserEigenvalue
    norm_num
    rw [hsign]
    nlinarith
  · have hi0 : 0 < i := by
      by_contra h
      have : i = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_not_pos h
      subst i
      have hone : (1 : ℝ) ≠ -1 := by norm_num
      exact hone (by simpa using hsign)
    have ha : n - k - i + (i - 1) = n - k - 1 := by omega
    have hb : k - i + (i - 1) = k - 1 := by omega
    have hchoose := choose_diagonal_mono (n - k - i) (k - i) (i - 1)
    rw [ha, hb] at hchoose
    unfold kneserEigenvalue
    norm_num
    rw [hsign]
    norm_num
    exact_mod_cast hchoose

name: SimpleGraph.KneserCounting.kneserEigenvalue_one_hasEigenvalue
statement:
private lemma kneserEigenvalue_one_hasEigenvalue
    {n k : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k) (hnk : 2 * k + 1 ≤ n) :
    Module.End.HasEigenvalue (adjacencyOperator n k) (kneserEigenvalue n k 1)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hn : 0 < n := by omega
  have hn2 : 2 ≤ n := by omega
  let p : Fin n := ⟨0, hn⟩
  let q : Fin n := ⟨1, by omega⟩
  have hpq : p ≠ q := by simp [p, q]
  let v : Vertex n k → ℝ :=
    incidenceVector n k {p} - incidenceVector n k {q}
  have hp := adjacency_incidenceVector (n := n) (k := k) hk {p} (by simp; omega)
  have hq := adjacency_incidenceVector (n := n) (k := k) hk {q} (by simp; omega)
  have hvapply : adjacencyOperator n k v = kneserEigenvalue n k 1 • v := by
    dsimp [v]
    rw [map_sub, hp, hq]
    funext A
    by_cases hpA : p ∈ (A : Finset (Fin n)) <;>
      by_cases hqA : q ∈ (A : Finset (Fin n)) <;>
        simp [incidenceVector, kneserEigenvalue, hpA, hqA]
  let s : Finset (Fin n) := ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).erase p).erase q
  have hps : p ∉ s := by simp [s]
  have hqs : q ∉ s := by simp [s]
  have hscard : #s = n - 2 := by
    simp [s, hpq.symm, Finset.card_erase_of_mem]
    omega
  have hkcard : k - 1 ≤ #s := by rw [hscard]; omega
  obtain ⟨T, hTs, hTcard⟩ := Finset.exists_subset_card_eq hkcard
  have hpT : p ∉ T := fun hpT ↦ hps (hTs hpT)
  have hqT : q ∉ T := fun hqT ↦ hqs (hTs hqT)
  have hAcard : #(insert p T) = k := by
    rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hpT, hTcard]
    omega
  let A : Vertex n k := ⟨insert p T, hAcard⟩
  have hvA : v A = 1 := by
    simp [v, incidenceVector, A, hpq.symm, hqT]
  have hvne : v ≠ 0 := by
    intro hv
    have := congrFun hv A
    rw [hvA] at this
    simp at this
  exact Module.End.hasEigenvalue_of_hasEigenvector
    ⟨Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff.mpr hvapply, hvne⟩

name: SimpleGraph.KneserCounting.kneserEigenvalue_one_isLeast
statement:
private lemma kneserEigenvalue_one_isLeast
    {n k : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k) (hnk : 2 * k + 1 ≤ n) :
    IsLeast (spectrum ℝ ((graph n k).adjMatrix ℝ)) (kneserEigenvalue n k 1)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · have heig := kneserEigenvalue_one_hasEigenvalue hk hnk
    have hmem : kneserEigenvalue n k 1 ∈ spectrum ℝ (adjacencyOperator n k) :=
      Module.End.HasEigenvalue.mem_spectrum heig
    simpa [adjacencyOperator] using hmem
  · intro μ hμ
    have hμ' : μ ∈ spectrum ℝ (adjacencyOperator n k) := by
      simpa [adjacencyOperator] using hμ
    have heig : Module.End.HasEigenvalue (adjacencyOperator n k) μ :=
      Module.End.hasEigenvalue_iff_mem_spectrum.mpr hμ'
    obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := hasEigenvalue_eq_kneserEigenvalue hk heig
    exact kneserEigenvalue_one_le hnk hi

name: SimpleGraph.KneserCounting.kneserEigenvalue_one_eq
statement:
private lemma kneserEigenvalue_one_eq
    {n k : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k) (hnk : 2 * k + 1 ≤ n) :
    kneserEigenvalue n k 1 =
      -((k : ℝ) / (((n - k : ℕ) : ℝ)) * (regularDegree n k : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have hnkpos : 0 < n - k := by omega
  have hidNat :
      (n - k) * (n - k - 1).choose (k - 1) =
        (n - k).choose k * k := by
    have hm : n - k - 1 + 1 = n - k := by omega
    have hk' : k - 1 + 1 = k := by omega
    simpa [hm, hk'] using Nat.add_one_mul_choose_eq (n - k - 1) (k - 1)
  have hid :
      ((n - k : ℕ) : ℝ) * ((n - k - 1).choose (k - 1) : ℝ) =
        ((n - k).choose k : ℝ) * (k : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hidNat
  have hden : (((n - k : ℕ) : ℝ)) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hnkpos.ne'
  unfold kneserEigenvalue regularDegree
  norm_num
  field_simp [hden]
  nlinarith [hid]

name: SimpleGraph.KneserCounting.kneser_least_eigenvalue
statement:
theorem kneser_least_eigenvalue
    {n k : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k) (hnk : 2 * k + 1 ≤ n) :
    IsLeast (spectrum ℝ ((graph n k).adjMatrix ℝ))
      (-((k : ℝ) / (((n - k : ℕ) : ℝ)) * (regularDegree n k : ℝ)))
proof:
:= by
  simpa [kneserEigenvalue_one_eq hk hnk] using kneserEigenvalue_one_isLeast hk hnk
